inconsistencies: #35724 is a prerequisite of #35558 (the prefill PR is stacked on it); review #35724 first even though it is the smaller logging change.
#34533 and #34457 both make wallet rebroadcasts use private broadcast; #34533 is the narrower fix and should be reviewed first, with #34457 then covering the send path and Qt handling.
#36277 is presented by its author as an alternative to #34707; a decision between them is needed, and #36277 (timing side channel) should be reviewed first.
#35600 and #36014 both address duplicate manual/added-node entries at startup; #35600 fixes the actual duplicate-connection race and should come first, #36014 only deduplicates arguments.
#27052 and #35315 both convert P2P timestamps to NodeClock::time_point in overlapping code; they will conflict and should be sequenced.
#35502 and #35522 are the same move-only decomposition applied to ProcessMessage and SendMessages; they were banded differently when assessed alone and are now equalised.
#30988, #35040, #34565, #34824 and #35561 are all parts of the net/net_processing split (#33958) and touch the same files; their merge order matters more than their individual priority.

#34271 is post-merge cleanup on private broadcast (#29415) whose usefulness is doubted by its own author while #34322/#36277/#34707 are actively reshaping the same subsystem; it should not be reviewed before them.
#35591 (Erlay) is marked DO NOT MERGE and the author intends to split it; the problem is P2-important but review attention belongs on the carve-outs when they appear.
result.notes: One P1: only #36015 describes an unmetered, remotely triggerable memory-exhaustion vector. Crash/security fixes that need non-default configuration or a hostile local Tor control port (#35919, #36142) sit at the top of P2 instead. The private-broadcast follow-up cluster (#34322, #34457, #34533, #34707, #36277, #34271) is six PRs deep on top of merged #29415 and should be triaged as a group. The net/net_processing refactor cluster was banded unevenly when assessed individually; it is now levelled at P3 except for the two pure move-only splits at P4.
